summary: Iteration 59: email verification (register/verify/resend/profile email change/reset), social pre-registration takeover protection (direct _upsert_social_user call), Énigme du soir (API + dashboard card desktop/mobile). Backend 10/10 pytest pass; frontend flows all pass (register -> banner -> resend toast; /verifier-email success -> banner gone, me.email_verified true; reuse -> error; riddle card hint/answer desktop + 390px, no horizontal overflow). One high-priority product/data issue: 188 of 189 existing users have no email_verified field, so they are treated as unverified.

critical.issue: 188/189 existing users (all created before this feature) have NO email_verified field. Consequences: (a) every existing real user now sees the 'Confirmez votre adresse' banner; (b) the first time any legacy user signs in with Google/Apple using the same email, their password is wiped (password_hash=None) and all sessions revoked, so they can no longer log in with email+password and must use 'Mot de passe oublié'. No migration/grandfathering exists. Decide: one-shot migration (e.g. set email_verified=True for users with first_login_at or quiz activity before the release date, or for auth_provider!='email') or at least use email_verified is False (explicit) instead of falsy in the takeover check.

minor.issue: Sets email_verified=True on the user's CURRENT email even if the reset token was issued for a previous address (record.email != user.email after a profile email change). Filter the update on {'email': record['email']} like verify-email does, or only set verified when emails match.
Returns 200 {ok:false} when Resend send fails; frontend toast shows 'Lien envoyé à …' anyway (EmailVerifyBanner ignores res.data.ok).
Email change does not notify the old address and does not bump token_version; consider sending an alert to the previous email (account-takeover hygiene).
Apple path does not check payload email_verified (Google path does). Apple usually sets it true, but for symmetry check it before linking by email.
Linking by email overwrites an existing different google_sub/apple_sub silently.

ui_bugs.issue: /verifier-email without token (or short token) shows raw English Pydantic message 'String should have at least 20 characters'. Short-circuit client-side when token missing/short and show the French message.

issues: Once 'Voir la réponse' is clicked there is no way to hide the answer again (spoiler for others at the table) — optional 'Masquer' button.

action_items: HIGH: handle the 188 legacy users without email_verified (migration/grandfathering) before shipping; otherwise all see the banner and a Google/Apple sign-in wipes their password
reset-password: only set email_verified when token email == current user email
EmailVerifyBanner: show error/info toast when resend returns ok:false
VerifyEmail page: French message when token missing/too short
Do NOT run old tests/test_email_update.py as is (it changes the admin email without current_password; now 403, update it to send current_password)
critical_code_review_comments: Token stored only as sha256 hash, single-use via atomic find_one_and_update, 48h TTL index, bound to email — good
Takeover protection logic correct: unverified -> password_hash None + token_version+1 (attacker session and password both revoked, verified by test); verified -> linked, password kept

evening_riddle: asyncio.Lock is per-process only; unique date index protects DB but a concurrent insert in another worker would raise DuplicateKeyError -> 503 once. Catch DuplicateKeyError and re-read.
password_reset_tokens are still stored in plaintext (unlike verify tokens) — consider hashing for consistency
seed_data_creation: TEST users created via register (pytest + 1 UI user test_ui59_*), all deleted by id with their tokens/ledger entries. Users count back to 189. Verification tokens planted directly in DB for tested users only (plaintext not retrievable). Riddle for 2026-11-27 already existed; no new date generated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/test_iteration59_email_verify_enigme.py (source backend/.env + frontend/.env). It only clears rate_limits keys ^(register|login|verify-mail). Onboarding tour skip: data-testid onboarding-tour-skip. Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of page but does not block clicks tested.
rca of the issue: Legacy-user issue: feature reads user.get('email_verified') as falsy for documents created before the field existed; no backfill in server startup/migrations.
